about: The art of the climb (Docs/LevelDesign.md, 'The art of the climb'). Each piece's 'gpu' names the Hawkes Gen jobs and assets its sources came from (entity sickofit/the-ember-wastes-climb-kit); download them into <src>/<piece>/ under the file names in its clips (hawkesgen_job save_to), then: python Tools/Art/climb_art.py Tools/Art/climb/climb.json --src <src>. The per-piece jobs beside this file are written by that run (their frame folders are in <src>/_prep).
